evidence: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow and Docker/Guix scripts under .github/workflows/guix.yml, ci/, and contrib/guix/libexec/.
rationale: Continuous testing of Guix release binaries and codesigning manifests catches packaging defects and toolchain issues before release engineering. As noted in the discussion, compiling and testing in a release context catches issues currently missed and unblocks testing for static toolchains like #25573.
